decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established range in a growing market, it is likely to remain above or near aspiration levels and the firm has enough slack to continue learning from it.

This articulated dumper fits the firm's core capabilities and customer base, so absent clear underperformance management would keep it while monitoring early market acceptance against internal and peer aspirations.

Because it is more distant from the established offer its results are more uncertain and more likely to fall short of aspirations, but the firm's engineering depth and current industry growth make one more year of search and evaluation plausible.
The compact telescopic loader builds on existing product and service strengths, so a boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless early results clearly miss aspiration levels.
